Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Industrial Zone
Cardtype: Master
Clan: Gangrel antitribu
Cost: 3 pool
Unique location.
Any Gangrel antitribu you control can add 1 blood to a Gangrel antitribu in your uncontrolled region as a +1 stealth action.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body: Heartblood of the Clan costs only 1 pool, and it hardly ever sees play. Why do you think the !Gangrel would benefit from it so much that they would happily pay 3 pool?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Heartblood of the Clan's action isn't at stealth.
!Gangrel have pool problems.
!Gangrel are prone to play Embrace due to their disciplineless combat cards.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
For 3 pool it's a bit harsh for a clan that doesn't have lots of pool defense. The outlay seems dangerous.

I'd be tempted to allow an untap if you kept the cost at 3 pool.

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418
